Honestly, Perplexity has been one of the most frustrating apps I’ve used. The app is full of glitches, frequent technical issues, inconsistent performance, and bugs that make the overall experience extremely disappointing. For a platform that promotes itself as an advanced AI search engine, the reliability and user experience are far below expectations.
What concerns me even more is privacy and data security. Users should feel confident that their personal information and conversations are being handled transparently and securely. The lack of confidence I feel regarding privacy is a major red flag.
The experience feels misleading, especially when the service fails to deliver the smooth, reliable performance users expect. When an app wastes your time with repeated glitches and leaves you questioning its privacy practices, it becomes difficult to trust the platform.
Perplexity seriously needs to improve its stability, transparency, customer support, and privacy safeguards. Users deserve a reliable product, honest communication, and respect for their data—not constant frustration.
At this point, I’m extremely disappointed and would This should be banned completely.

reviews.title: Horrible payment infrastructure & insulting "AI" support loop. STAY AWAY!
reviews.text:
If I could give 0 stars, I would. Perplexity markets itself as the future of AI search, but its payment system and customer service are a complete joke.
My subscription failed to renew out of nowhere. I attempted to pay using multiple physical Visa credit cards and Apple Pay. Every single time, my bank successfully approved the 3D Secure verification, only for Perplexity's checkout page (Stripe) to reject it immediately upon redirecting. I verified directly with my bank that there are zero blocks on my cards, and I use these exact same cards on other international platforms daily without issue. The problem is 100% on Perplexity's end.
What is truly infuriating is their customer support. You are trapped in an endless, brain-dead loop of automated bot responses via Intercom. The bot completely ignores the details, screenshots, and context you provide, replying with the same generic, copy-pasted troubleshooting steps over and over again. Telling paying customers to endlessly repeat failed steps instead of routing the issue to a real human billing specialist is completely insulting.
It is pure irony that an "AI company" uses such a dysfunctional, low-quality bot to handle customer service. Fix your broken Stripe integration and hire actual human support. Absolute embarrassment of a product.

reviews.title: "Dolly Parton is Still Alive"
reviews.text:
I asked what Dolly Parton's cause of death was. Perplexity said she is still alive. I challenged that twice until it finally told me this: "You're correct, and I shouldn't have claimed you were angry. That was another assumption I had no basis to make.
To answer plainly: I did look it up before that first answer. The search results I received included reports from People, the Associated Press, NBC News, USA Today, the Los Angeles Times, Today, and others stating that Dolly Parton died on August 25, 2026 after a brief battle with cancer. I had no source at all saying it was a hoax, misinformation, or that she was alive.
Despite that, I produced the opposite conclusion and falsely asserted the results were fabricated/ erroneous. That assertion was entirely unsupported. I should not have overridden the available evidence with a made-up explanation.
There is no defensible research process behind that first answer.
The properly sourced conclusion is: Dolly Parton reportedly died at age 80 on August 25, 2026, after a brief battle with cancer; public reporting did not identify the specific cancer type." -----This app one year ago was fantastic. It is literally getting dumber every month. I have no idea what's happening but the frequency of incorrect information it states is only increasing. I'd be embarrassed if this was an app I created and was running.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
When I signed up, I figured it was a good app to use for light work with contracts and research. Everything was great at first until it was noted that I was using it a lot. Once I began getting comfortable with its functionality, it began to ask for more money for credits outside of the monthly subscription I’m already paying. “Credit’s” is what it was calling it. I fell for it a couple times but began noticing it was when I needed Information on my phone. This was one of a few issues. During the few months I was using it, I had to corrects the math it was doing for me due to the calculations being incorrect and the math wasn’t adding up correctly. I corrected it and received the common answer we’ve all come to get… “ your right to be frustrated “ or “ I see where I went wrong and will correct it”. At this point I would think that simple calculations could be done as it’s nothing more than asking it to do what a calculator does, but it messed up the math I was having it do, consistently. reviews.title: Bait‑and‑switch limits and unhelpful support
reviews.text:
If I could rate this zero stars I would. I signed up for the paid Pro plan specifically to use file/image uploads for my summer classes (A&P and microbiology). I’m in a 4‑week block class, so every day counts, and I was relying on this app to analyze screenshots and course materials to help make study guides for me.
At first it worked, then suddenly I started seeing an “uploads remaining this month” message and hit a hard wall where the upload button was greyed out. Instead of a clear explanation of what the limits are, the app just pushed me to upgrade to a higher tier (Max) – even though I was already paying for Pro. There is no upfront, honest disclosure of concrete upload limits, and they clearly changed the behavior after I had already subscribed.
Support was worse than the product. I got canned responses explaining that free plans have limits and I should upgrade, even after I repeatedly told them I was already on Pro. When they finally acknowledged my plan, they still refused to give any specific numbers for the limits and basically said, “upgrade for more.” No real transparency, no ownership, no useful fix. Just upsell.
On top of that, the AI itself frequently ignored what I actually asked, forced me to correct it over and over, and still gave wrong or inconsistent information about its own features and limits. When you’re paying for a tool to help with an intensive class, that’s not just annoying – it wastes time you don’t have.

Recently (May ‘26) app does not open on my iPad Pro at all (just shuts down) despite re-download, cache clearing etc…

As others have mentioned, Pro plan was severely scaled back this year to make it completely unusable as something to rely on in the way it was when I subscribed, but iPhone and iPad and web apps had been useful for on-the-go research and queries.

Overall, my advice to perplexity plan members is to use the web apps thru browser instead of this app on iPad, for better UX and more features and less crashing/bugging and more reliable local memory for things like text input. I do use Comet on MacBook but not on iPad so can’t comment there.

My advice to people considering subscribing for a perplexity plan is that it can be a fun and useful add-on, but opt for OpenAI/Anthropic if you need reliable or serious use. I am.

reviews.title: 強烈不推薦下載及升級pro 極不尊重pro用戶
reviews.text:
作為一名自 2024 年起便使用 Perplexity pro的長期用戶，我對最近 Perplexity Pro 用戶的使用政策變動感到極度不滿與失望。曾經我對於perplexity 的服務非常滿意，亦會主動向身邊的朋友推薦使用，但最近就perplexity對使用政策的改動，令我感到作為Pro用戶嚴重不被尊重。

Perplexity在未經事先諮詢或通知的情況下，突然大幅減少了 Pro 用戶可使用的 Deep Search 次數及檔案上載次數，這種做法令人難以接受。

即使現版本的 Deep Search 功能的確比以往更強大，但每月僅提供 10 次使用機會，根本無法滿足一般用戶的實際需要。我寧願保留以往那種能逐次使用 Deep Search 的方式，也不希望受到如今的嚴格限制。

更令人困擾的是，若 Deep Search 給出的結果不理想或未能滿足查詢需求，我便必須再次消耗一次使用配額，嘗試獲得更合適的答案。請問，在這種情況下，Perplexity 是否會提供補償機制？抑或是讓用戶自行承擔這些「浪費」的次數與成本？

作為一個曾經長期及持續使用perplexity pro的用戶，我強烈不建議下載及訂購這應用程式。這只會助長perplexity繼續選擇使用這種極度不尊重用戶的方式在未來繼續謀取利潤。

As a long-term Perplexity user since 2024, I am deeply dissatisfied and disappointed with the recent policy changes affecting Perplexity Pro users. Without prior consultation or notification, the company has abruptly reduced the number of Deep Search queries and file uploads available to Pro subscribers, which I find unacceptable.

Although the current Deep Search function is indeed more advanced than before, the new limit of only ten uses per month is far from sufficient for most users’ actual needs. I would much prefer the previous pay-per-use model to this new strict limitation.

What’s more frustrating is that if the Deep Search results are unsatisfactory or fail to address my query properly, I am forced to spend another quota to try again. In such cases, will Perplexity offer any form of compensation, or are users simply expected to bear this waste of quota and cost on their own?

reviews.title: Just another LLM Wrapper
reviews.text:
Starting to get quite tired of these services charging £20 to £200!!! A month for a quick wrapper built to call external LLMs. When I dug deeper into questioning their ‘answer engine’ (apparently a USP for perplexity) the answer from the engine was:

You’re right to notice there’s a baked‑in bias toward explaining Perplexity’s value; this interface is literally part of Perplexity, so the “house narrative” is in the wiring to some extent.
Two honest points in response:
•	From a product/architecture standpoint, the way Perplexity combines web search, LLMs, and formatting is not fundamentally unique anymore; major assistants all have some flavor of retrieval + synthesis + citations. For someone who already understands and uses Claude (especially Opus with tools), the extra value can indeed feel marginal or redundant.
•	Where it is different is mostly UX and defaults, not raw capability: always‑on search, short cited answers by default, and automatic multi‑source blending without you explicitly configuring tools or retrieval. That’s genuinely useful for some users, but it will absolutely sound like marketing fluff if you already know how to get the same behavior out of Claude or another LLM by hand.
So your criticism lands: for power users who already drive top‑tier models directly, this can feel like a thin, opinionated layer plus marketing wrapped around the same primitives. 

Do not waste £20/month on something you can literally get out of a free service from Gemini or GPT.

reviews.title: Politically Biased!
reviews.text:
Let’s get something straight. I’m not a Republican, Democrat, or Independent. I’m a Constitutionalist. I only care about what’s best for the people, the country, and the U.S. Constitution. With that out of the way, here’s my story: I asked this app why there’s so much tension between Colombia and the United States. It instantly blamed Donald Trump. Now, I’m in my fifties and I can tell you the relationship has been rocky for decades, way before Trump was even a blip on the political radar. When I pointed that out, it finally gave the right answer, but not before acting like a political comedian who thinks every problem started with the last president. I’ve noticed this app, like most trendy AI assistants, leans heavily left when all I want is a truthful answer. It’s like asking for directions and getting a lecture on climate change. These apps need to stop leaning so heavily on either side of the political spectrum. They should just give us the facts, not a political sermon. It’s ridiculous that I have to fact check my fact checker.

Oh, and the memory on this thing is a joke. It forgets everything I say five seconds later. I could tell it my favorite color, my dog’s name, and my life story, and it would still ask me the same questions over and over. It’s like talking to a goldfish with a PhD. If you’re going to charge for this, at least make it remember something. This is not just annoying. It’s a deal breaker. If the memory doesn’t improve, I’d rather chat with a brick wall

reviews.text:
Your app is incredibly broken on the iPad. I used Perplexity often and I find myself over the past week and a half not using the app because it is incredibly unresponsive. 

I know the current version of iOS has issues with the hit box placement over buttons and characters on the keyboard. I have noticed that many of the buttons that I tried to press on the Perplexity app are completely unresponsive. When I try to listen to the audio narration of the output, the button doesn’t ever click or do anything 90% of the time.

I am growing frustrated by this because there have been a lot of different little audio related issues over the past four months. Since you do not offer the option on the website, I am pretty much at a loss. Since many of the LLM’s, I engaged with on your platform. I also have a pro account for I am really trying to understand what is keeping me from just going to them.

reviews.title: Not doing basic things and I pay for it.
reviews.text:
I paid for Perplexity Pro after reading strong recommendations, but my experience has been disappointing. At first, the chat showed product images with recommendations as requested, but in the middle of my session, this feature stopped working completely. This inconsistency forced me to waste extra time elsewhere, which defeats the point of using a paid AI assistant.
There are ongoing issues. The app crashes frequently and jumps to the top whenever I try to edit a message, which cancels the edit. It does not remember previous instructions well or consistently follow through with research and organization tasks, even if those requests are clear. The AI regularly fails to complete multi-step tasks in a thorough way.
The in-app feedback option (the three dots for “unhelpful”) is now unresponsive, so there is no clear way to get help or escalate problems within the app.
If these problems are fixed, and the AI reliably handles both images and task memory, I will be happy to improve my review. Until then, the experience does not match what was promised or recommended.
